description:
Descriere loc de muncă: Inginer AI

As an AI Engineer, you will focus on designing, developing and deploying machine learning models and artificial intelligence solutions that drive impactful business decisions. You will be responsible for building end-to-end pipelines, integrate AI capabilities into enterprise environments, ensuring that models are production-ready, scalable, and contribute directly to digital transformation and operational efficiency.

Responsabilități:

  • Together with us, you have the chance to grow everyday, contributing to energy transition, being responsible of:

·       Design, build, and deploy machine learning models using Python and frameworks such as PyTorch, ensuring models are robust, scalable, and optimized for performance.

·       Building and orchestrating AI agent workflows using agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LiveKit, and OpenAIAgentsSDK, including solutions such as enterprise chatbots, internal AI productivity assistants, document intelligence systems, and automated agent workflows.

·       Designing and validating agent behavior using MCP (Model Context Protocol), Guardrails, and structured Agent Instructions, ensuring safety, consistency, and compliance.

Cerințe:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Programming expertise in Python
  • Proficiency in NLP and LLMs
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient production-level code, adhering to best practices in software engineering (e.g., version control, testing, CI/CD).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Good English knowledge (upper intermediate level).
  • Italian language skills are a plus
